purchases.SERIES_CODE: chart-total, chart-yoy, chart-tree, chart-growth, chart-sub — the sector tree comes from code prefixes
purchases.SERIES_NAME_HE: chart-yoy, chart-tree, chart-sub — sector labels (last facet of BoI's name)
purchases.TIME_PERIOD: chart-total, chart-yoy, chart-growth, kpi:level, kpi:yoy, kpi:m4
purchases.OBS_VALUE: chart-total, chart-yoy, chart-tree, chart-growth, chart-sub, kpi:level, kpi:base
purchases.UNIT_MULT: chart-total, kpi:level — scales values to millions of shekels
purchases.DATA_SOURCE: skip: constant SHVA, credited in the lede
purchases.INTERNAL_PROCESS: skip: constant BoI research process code
purchases.ADJUSTMENT: skip: constant Y (seasonally adjusted), stated in every note
purchases.ACTIVITY: skip: BoI activity code, one-to-one with SERIES_CODE
purchases.TRANSFORMATION: skip: constant A7 (7-day moving average), stated in the notes
purchases.UNIT_MEASURE: skip: constant ILS, stated in labels
purchases.PRICES: skip: constant V (current prices), stated in the notes
purchases.COMMENTS: skip: empty for every series in this dataflow
